jlink_mcp.title: J-Link MCP V1
jlink_mcp.description: Windows x64 local stdio MCP for one SEGGER J-Link target.
args: $dir = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\jlink-mcp'; $mcp = Join-Path $dir 'jlink-mcp.exe'; $worker = Join-Path $dir 'jlink-worker.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $mcp -PathType Leaf) -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $worker -PathType Leaf)) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('J-Link MCP binaries are missing. Run scripts/install-codex-plugin.ps1 from the jlink-mcp-V2 repository.'); exit 127 }; & $mcp; exit $LASTEXITCODE
